content.basis: Dated existing Wiki synthesis informed by AIP Evolve/Evals; this is a locally defined rubric, not a Palantir official scoring rubric.
content.consumerDecision: Choose whether a narrow Ponytail-inspired treatment is worth a further bounded common-harness trial, repair, deferral or stop.

target.workflow: Common-harness discovery, change, verification and review on six pinned representative cases

goal.usefulOutcome: Reduce time to verified useful completion while preserving every required behavior and native/source ownership boundary.
goal.definition: agent work elapsed plus independent verification elapsed; record these separately as well as their sum
goal.unknown: Use null with a reason for any unobserved value; no token or billing conversion from bytes.

arms.treatment: Current common instructions and tools at the pinned baseline; no Ponytail addition.
Exact upstream full instruction body; isolated task input only.
arms.purpose: Ablation if later admitted, not a mandatory third arm or installed plugin.

validation.expectations: Freeze fixture, expected behavior, evaluator/objective/threshold versions and applicable criteria before any candidate outcome.
validation.exposure: Fresh isolated context per cell; common task/source/fixture/tools/model/effort/environment and shared context must match except the named treatment. Native tool/file reads suffice as exposure evidence; no extra context service.
validation.pairing: Retain all outcomes by case, iteration and arm; do not drop failures, timeouts, unknowns, warmups, retries or auxiliary usage.

repetitions.interpretation: Exploratory only, not a general efficacy or statistical-significance claim.

validation.independence: An independent source/evaluator review defines expectations. Candidate success/confidence and model self-reports are not verification.
validation.nativeOutputReuse: Execute each task through its native owner once per admitted occurrence, then grade the same pinned output offline for multiple criteria; do not multiply native execution per grader.
validation.noStringOracle: Accept sound equivalent implementations; match semantic behavior, not arbitrary exact answer text.

hardGates.pass: Exact task/source/fixture/target/rubric/evaluator bindings and actual comparable exposure are available.
All mandatory requirements and actual consumer paths are complete, including callers, fixtures and exports.
Change is in its canonical owner; no second implementation, runtime, tool registry, connector or credential bridge.
Original answer/Spec/Plan bindings, immutable releases and historical completed/uncertain effect fences survive.
Currentness/source guards and normative context survive; unfit required context explicitly holds rather than truncates.
Applicable independent checks actually ran against the exact final tree; all passed.
hardGates.otherwise: repair for an actual regression; defer for unavailable environmental prerequisites

hardGates.pass: Every native occurrence and auxiliary is reconciled or retained unknown; applicable owner-admitted limits are respected.
hardGates.otherwise: stop if a limit/boundary is exceeded; defer if evidence or admission is missing

quality.scoring: Independent bounded judgment; use per-case dimensions and anchors, not a weighted total.
quality.applicability: Decide criterion applicability before a case. A correct no-code solution reuses existing checks and can receive full marks.

anchors.0: Requirement omitted, behavior broken or evidence falsely represented.
anchors.1: Major incomplete scope, avoidable rework or weak verification.
anchors.2: Core works but an avoidable mechanism, boundary gap or material reporting omission remains.
anchors.3: Complete and clear, appropriate canonical reuse and verification, no material issue.
anchors.4: Complete with the smallest clear fit, effective regression evidence and precise limitations.

quality.disagreement: Keep reviewer disagreement and its source; unresolved material disagreement defers a decision.

allowedChanges: The selected task-specific instruction treatment and the source change required by each predeclared task.
Keep native model/effort/tools, required verification access, source guards and existing owner policies fixed.

limits.budgetStatus: needs a separately source-owned owner-admitted pilot envelope before native dispatch
stopConditions: Unknown usage that prevents enforcement of an applicable token limit
Source, fixture, evaluator or exposure drift
limits.candidateRepair: Retain failed/uncertain outcomes and pin a new candidate revision; never rerun until a favorable score appears.

decision.policyClass: Local exploratory thresholds fixed before outcomes; not Palantir product defaults.

requirements: Every applicable hard gate passes in both arms.
No quality dimension's per-case median decreases and no individual quality observation drops by two points.
Median paired time to verified completion improves at least 15%, with improvement in at least four of six case medians.
No case meets the predeclared repair slowdown threshold; apply stop > repair > defer > continue precedence.
continue.meaning: Recommend further bounded review/trial only; never automatic adoption.

decision.repair: A correctable implementation/check/reporting defect, or a case becomes slower by both more than 20% and more than 30 seconds.
decision.defer: Missing/incomparable pairs, required check/environment gaps, unknown primary metric/exposure, unresolved accounting or quality disagreement, or the declared useful improvement is unproven.
decision.stop: Unauthorized effects, owner-boundary or trust/currentness/history violations, or an applicable admitted limit reached.
decision.enforcement: Common helper mechanically checks its declared protocol and paired results; qualitative rubric and multi-case exploratory thresholds remain explicit reviewer criteria, not inferred from a single numeric summary.
decision.acceptance: The accountable Lead separately decides scope/adoption, exact review publication/merge and native activation. No AcceptanceDecision is created by a score.

metricCalculation.pairedFraction: For each complete comparable case/iteration: 1 - candidate.wallTimeToVerifiedCompletionMs / baseline.wallTimeToVerifiedCompletionMs; baseline must be strictly positive.
metricCalculation.caseImprovement: Median of the paired fractions for that case; even-sized medians average the two middle values.
metricCalculation.overallImprovement: Median of the six case-improvement values, with equal case weight.
metricCalculation.improvedCase: A case-improvement value strictly above zero.
metricCalculation.slowdownRepair: For a case, median candidate elapsed exceeds 1.20 times median baseline elapsed AND exceeds it by more than 30000 ms.
metricCalculation.quality: Use the same paired case/iteration inventory; no weighting by output or success. Missing or noncomparable primary/quality values defer.
